# Witness

> Witness is an evidence-first sanity-test automation tool for QA teams running Xray/Jira test cases against live game builds. It flags ambiguous test steps and unresolved preconditions instead of guessing, captures screenshot/video/log evidence for every run, and requires human review before any Jira defect is filed.

Witness executes a configured stable subset of Xray test cases against mobile (iOS/Android webview) and PC (browser) builds of a PixiJS/WebGL game, driving the live rendered scene graph directly via Playwright and Appium — object lookup against real coordinates, not an accessibility tree or vision-based self-healing. Every result links back to its originating Xray test case ID and build number. Known preconditions (account level, currency, feature flags, server time) are set deliberately per run from a named preset (e.g. "new-player", "high-roller") and the exact applied values are recorded alongside the evidence.

Core guarantees (see the Home page for the full rationale behind each):
- Never reports an ambiguous, blocked, or assumption-dependent run as a clean pass.
- No result is reported without screenshot, video, log, and build-metadata evidence.
- A human reviewer approves, rejects, or splits every candidate defect before a Jira bug is filed — the system proposes, it never files a ticket unattended.
- Every run, piece of evidence, and candidate defect traces back to its Xray test case ID and build number.
- A test step with no resolvable target is flagged as an authoring gap, kept separate from real product defects.
